title: Time complexity with advice
statement: For functions $T,a\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, this class consists of languages of Boolean words for which there are a constant $c\in\mathbb{N}$, an advice function $\alpha\colon\mathbb{N}\to\{\text{Boolean lists}\}$, and a finite Turing machine such that $|\alpha(n)|=a(n)$ for every $n$, and the machine decides the language with advice $\alpha$ within time $cT$.
hypotheses_covered: An advice function assigning Boolean lists exists
A finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet exists
Advice length is exactly $a(n)$ for every natural number $n$
The machine decides the language with advice within time $n\mapsto cT(n)$
